text: 今年前三个季度，中国进出口银行新发放外贸领域贷款近万亿元，同比增长9%，其中近40%投向稳外贸主体和稳外贸产业链领域。重点支持传统贸易与新业态新模式，助力发展数字贸易、绿色贸易。（央视）
text_en: In the first three quarters of this year, the Export-Import Bank of China issued nearly 1 trillion yuan in new loans to the foreign trade sector, up 9% year on year, with nearly 40% directed toward stabilizing foreign trade entities and foreign trade industrial chains. It focused on supporting traditional trade and new forms and models, helping develop digital trade and green trade. (CCTV)
